questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How long it takes to travel to Mars
Why men walked on the Moon first
How to grow plants and food in space on long journeys
Women in space and the first person on Mars
questions.why: Neil says the programme is about the women who want to be the first to set foot on the red planet.

questions.q: How does Rob describe his long flight to Australia and New Zealand?
options: Boring and cramped, but he loved the destination
Exciting and comfortable
Short and easy
Frightening because of the bad weather during the flight
questions.why: Rob says it was pretty boring and cramped on the plane, 'but I loved it when I got there'.

options: The first woman walked in space
A third of workers were women for the first time
Equal numbers of women and men joined as astronaut trainees
NASA stopped recruiting men
questions.why: Rob says 2016 was the first year equal numbers of women and men joined as astronaut trainees.

questions.q: What did Karen Nyberg hope when she was selected as an astronaut in 2000?
options: To be the very first person to walk on the planet Mars
That her group might be the next to go to the Moon
To live on the space station for a year
To become NASA's first female pilot
questions.why: She says she thought 'we would be the ones, the next to go to the Moon'.

questions.q: How does Karen Nyberg feel about not going to the Moon?
options: Angry with NASA for choosing other people
Relieved
She doesn't care
Disappointed, but she understands
questions.why: She calls it 'unfortunate', which Rob explains means disappointed but perhaps understanding why.

questions.q: What does Rob think astronauts are really like?
options: Mainly spaceship pilots
More like scientists doing experiments
Mostly engineers who fix machines
Tourists who enjoy travel
questions.why: Rob says 'really I think they are much more like scientists, carrying out different experiments'.

questions.q: Why does Neil mention growing food on Mars?
options: To show why a plant scientist like Gioia Massa matters
To say that Mars has good soil
To joke about Rob's cooking
To show that the mission is impossible without better food
questions.why: He says a base on Mars would need food, so people with those skills, like Gioia Massa.

questions.q: What does Gioia Massa say about her own abilities?
options: She was the best at maths in her class
She is good at every part of her job, including maths
She was weak at maths and handwriting, but good with plants
She wanted to be a pilot but failed
questions.why: She says she wasn't as great in math, her handwriting is terrible, but 'plants were my strength'.
